text:
samir: quick async — what I did: finished the KMS rotation dry run for staging, pushed scripts to infra repo.

elaine: nice. any fallout from the dry run?

samir: no errors in the runbook, but saw one key with pending versions flagged by the script (needs manual promote). added note in the PR.

pjordan: blocker: I hit a perms issue when trying to run the rotate job in prod account — `PermissionDenied` on `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.update`. Could use a hand to confirm iam role mapping.

marco: I can pair after standup. likely the service-account missing `roles/cloudkms.admin` on the key ring.

samir: thanks — I left the IAM diff in the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/342 — includes the minimal role change plus audit log entries.

elaine: FYI compliance asked for evidence of the rotation policy by EOD. can we export the rotation dry-run log?

samir: yes: ran `gsutil cp /var/logs/kms-rotate/* gs://redwood-audit/kms-dryrun/2419876543/` and granted read to compliance group.

security-bot: Incident check: no active incidents for KMS. Automated scan found 1 key with weak policy (fixed in next PR). :white_check_mark:

pjordan: plan for today: debug prod perms, open a follow-up for prod dry run once perms are fixed, and ping infra to schedule a maintenance window.

marco: I'll submit the IAM grant change to the owner list and post the schedule in #eng-oncall.

elaine: I'll collate the rotation artifacts and attach to the compliance ticket: CMP-1224.

samir: FYI vuln remediation: ran the container CVE scan on the KMS operator image — found two moderate CVEs, created MR with updated base image. link: https://git.internal/redwood/secure-images/merge/78

pjordan: thx. once the MR merges, I'll cut the operator release and stage the rollout behind the canary policy.

marco: question for infra: do we want to enable auto-rotate for keys older than 90 days?

elaine: agree on 90d but let's stage with non-prod first. I'll add to the policy doc.

samir: anything else?

pjordan: code review pings: please review `infra/kms/rotate.sh` (small change) and `secure-images/Dockerfile` MR. low risk.

marco: ack, will review in next hour.

elaine: ack from me after I attach compliance artifacts.

security-bot: Reminder: weekly key-audit sweep scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC. :bell:

samir: thanks — marking done for today.

pjordan: thanks team.

marco: :thumbsup:
